# Official Ballot Reference — Malta General Election 2026
**Source: Electoral Commission of Malta**
**Election date: 30 May 2026**

> This file contains the complete official candidate nominations as registered with the Electoral Commission.
> Names appear exactly as registered on the ballot (Surname, Name format).
> 282 total nominations · 162 unique candidates · 13 districts.
>
> **Parties:** Partit Laburista (Labour) · Partit Nazzjonalista (PN) · Momentum · AD+PD (ADPD) · Aħwa Maltin · Imperium Europa · Independent

---

## HOW TO USE THIS FILE

- **Ballot name = the authoritative legal registered name.** Public/display names used in campaign materials may differ.
- Where a candidate's public name differs from their ballot name, the district comparison files note: `*(Official ballot name: X)*`
- Multi-district candidates appear once per district they contest.
- Known name discrepancies between ballot and public usage are tracked in `Candidate_Name_Verification_Process.md` and `Multi_District_Candidate_Catalogue.md`.
